Unpublished estimates from the 2003--2007 National Health Interview Survey.

the poorest (<100% of the poverty threshold) were approximately twice as likely to need help with ADLs as the least poor
Older adults were more likely to have 3--6 ADLs than 1--2 ADLs, except for the poorest group where the difference was not statistically significant.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.

methods_quotes.q: the poverty ratio was calculated using the 2003--2007 National Health Interview Survey multiple imputed family income and personal earnings data files
Persons with unknown ADL status were excluded from the denominators.
